jobs.prompt: Landscape 16:9 editorial illustration. A Korean family of four (two parents, a girl about 8 and a boy about 12) sit around a living-room table in the evening, planning a three-night road trip to the east coast of Korea. On the table: an open paper map of the coastline covered with many small colorful location pins, a few sticky notes with tiny clock doodles, and a smartphone lying face up. The father rubs his forehead, puzzled; the mother traces lines between pins with a pencil; the kids point excitedly at a printed beach photo. Above the table, faint dotted route lines tangle between floating pin icons like a knot, showing how hard it is to decide the order of places across days. Warm lamp light. Palette: deep navy, sky blue, warm sand and a little coral on an off-white background. Clean vector-like shapes, subtle paper grain, soft shadows, generous empty space. No written words, letters, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere.

Landscape 16:9 editorial illustration of the interior of a modern parked car, seen from just behind the two front seats. The car's wide center touchscreen shows a large square scan code next to a simple map with a dotted route line. The front passenger holds a smartphone up toward the screen to scan the code; the phone shows the same dotted route. A small padlock symbol floats between the phone and the screen, joined to both by a thin light line, suggesting a secure one-time transfer. Nobody is driving: the car is stopped in a quiet seaside parking lot in the morning, with pine trees and a calm sea visible through the windshield. Palette: deep navy, sky blue, warm sand on off-white. Clean vector-like shapes, soft shadows, calm mood. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos or emblems on the car, screen or phone.

Landscape 16:9 editorial illustration from the driver's seat of a car cruising along a sunny coastal road on the east coast of Korea, sea on the right, pine-covered hills on the left. The driver's hands are on the steering wheel and eyes on the road; no phone is in use. The wide center display shows a clean navigation map with one highlighted route passing through several round waypoint markers, plus a slim status strip with a small clock icon and a check mark, minimal and uncluttered for driving. Floating softly above the dashboard, a translucent row of small round icons connected by a line (fork and spoon, coffee cup, wave, bed) represents the day's plan staying on time. Palette: deep navy, sky blue, warm sand with a touch of green, off-white sky. Clean vector-like shapes, soft light. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere.

A 2x2 four-panel storyboard illustration, landscape 16:9 overall, thin white gutters between panels, the same Korean family of four (two parents, a girl about 8, a boy about 12) in every panel. Top left: at home in the evening, the mother adds places to a map on her smartphone while the kids lean in. Top right: inside the parked car, the passenger scans a code shown on the car's center screen with a phone. Bottom left: the car drives along a coastal highway beside the sea; the driver watches the road and the center screen shows a route line with a small calm clock icon. Bottom right: the family arrives at a seaside restaurant in the late afternoon, smiling, the car parked behind them. Consistent clean vector-like editorial style, palette of deep navy, sky blue, warm sand and a little coral on off-white, soft shadows. No speech bubbles, captions, written words, letters, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere.

Landscape 16:9 editorial illustration of a tidy rental car lot at dawn with a row of identical compact electric cars. A staff member in a navy jacket holds a tablet showing battery level bars beside small route-line thumbnails for the upcoming customers' trips. Two cars are plugged into charging posts; one car has a small amber attention marker floating above it, flagged to charge before handover. In the background a traveling family with suitcases walks toward a car that is ready, with a small green check above it. Palette: deep navy, sky blue, warm sand with amber and green accents on an off-white morning sky. Clean vector-like shapes, soft shadows, orderly calm mood. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos or brand marks on the cars, signs or devices.
